title: Two sketches can share a register
hook: Two summaries may have seen some of the same hashes.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Uniform hash/draw assumptions; probability and weighted ranks as stated.
doesNotKnow: Merge HyperLogLog sketches by registerwise maxima, not by adding estimates.

misconception: Distinct-count estimates from overlapping streams can simply be added.
objective: Merge HyperLogLog sketches by registerwise maxima, not by adding estimates.

claims.text: Each bucket remembers only the largest leading-zero rank in its suffix. Registerwise maximum represents the union, even when the same hash occurs in both inputs; adding registers would count that evidence twice.
